body:
Quick pass (the PR's own head, worked one binary at a time - the lane list the orders named; the incremental diff touches cl and app source plus their test files, no motion or sim source):

- `cargo test -p camcraft-cl --lib` - 76 passed (the 9 `rotary_unwind` pins, the new feed-retract pin among them).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` - 312 passed (the 10 `rotary_gate` pins, the new radial-unwind pin among them).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test rotary_field_parity` - 4 passed, 9 ignored (heavy lanes; the two new Flow lanes also ran locally in release: parity ok in 82.8 s, eye cost ok in 3.5 s).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test rotary_flow_band` - 6 passed (the millturn unwind acceptance, the #906 unrated refusal, the narrow-travel refusal).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test c_axis_unwind` - 7 passed (the contour unwind unchanged through the enum).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test rotary_verify` - 10 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test operations` - 125 passed, 6 ignored (the pre-existing heavy set).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test rotary_face_selection` - 5 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean.

The body is complete (readings, pins, not-exercised, changelog, `Fixes #2828`), the branch merges cleanly with `main`'s tree only through the stacked parent #3999, and the PR obeys the file: no snapshot PNGs, no process files, the decisions file in `docs/decisions/`. Flagging ready.

The local trial merge is `018a2a0aa010e00770b303395b3572337a2a413b`. Its first parent is the PR head above.
There is no earlier collaborator review of this PR.

What looks good:

- The radial unwind keeps the travel and C-rate refusal checks. The band stays a continuous chain through the rewind.
- The column verdict still refuses rotary programs. The field eye uses the measured Flow path.
- The catalog and golden comparisons passed. No epsilon changed in the parity test.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/multiaxis_page.rs:250` — The PR changes the Flow editor and icons, but its body has no before/after screenshots. Add both views to this PR body. Store the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/multiaxis_page.rs:261` — The new arm discards `stated_axis`. A user cannot set or clear the operation's rotation axis in the GUI. Files and MCP can set this value. Bind the field and call `rotary_stated_axis_editor` in the Passes tab. Pin Apply and undo with a structural test.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/multiaxis_page.rs:274` — `retract_hop` seeds its value from its top argument plus 1 mm. Both arguments here are the clearance radius. Enabling "Hop below clearance" therefore sets a retract radius ABOVE clearance. The control also calls the value "Retract Z" and describes a plane. Use a radial control with a valid seed at or below clearance. Label it "Retract radius" and describe the cylinder. Pin the toggle and the displayed text.
4. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/multiaxis_page.rs:282` — `axis_editor` says that lead and maximum tilt are measured from the surface normal. `rotary_flow_emit::cut_pose` measures them from the radial direction. These directions differ on tapered and helical surfaces. Use `rotary_axis_editor` and pin the radial wording.
5. `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:203` — The writer moves every saved project from v81 to v82. A v81 reader refuses the new files, including files without Flow operations. No commit records this compatibility break with `!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Add the required breaking-change metadata in a new commit. The current main AGENTS.md requires this metadata for an incompatible project-file change.
6. `crates/app/tests/rotary_flow_band.rs:1` — This diff adds a new top-level test binary. The PR body instead says that no top-level binary was added. Add the one-line reason required by "New tests join a directory suite", or move the tests into a directory suite. Correct the body statement.

These were input mutations in the PR tests. I did not edit source code for mutation testing.

and all three catalog suites passed.

Optional, non-blocking:

- Restore the removed provenance line in `crates/app/src/operation/params.rs:1`.
- The Flow fixtures do not prove successful posted NC output. Their comments report a gouge warning that blocks the post.
  This review verifies the tested generation and refusal paths. It does not certify successful Flow posting.

I made only the local trial-merge commit. I did not edit source code or commit review evidence. Nothing was pushed. The warm worktree and branch remain in place.
I will set `needs-rework` for the six requested changes. The contributor's ready flag stays unchanged.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
